method: Shared organ-registration and exact-existing-parent correspondence displacement interpolation; source face rows/corners and materials retained, normals recomputed. Existing 23 gastric vessels unchanged.
normalPolicy: Smooth normals from exact coincident exported float32 vertices, remapped to original source corners
limitations: Source-derived display coordinates, not measured anatomy.
Temporary contacts and organ penetration are reported; no universal zero-contact, caliber, or patent-lumen claim.
Source physical-contact inventory is undirected; missing inferior branches are not synthesized.

Current registered surfaces retain temporary organ contacts, including sampled posterior-branch pancreas depth up to 6.71 mm. New anterior-branch/GDA contact is not evidence of a source anatomical junction.
Named superior branches are included; a complete pancreaticoduodenal arcade and all organ-wall terminal distributions are not represented.

hierarchy.note: Named members, not a separate common superior trunk.
